_note: Proposed by BE-W for F06 (D81). Numbers to be assigned by Content; wording drafted, writers own it. L-new.wallet_credit_line is the item line of a wallet_credit order on its receipt (D37): money received that could not confirm a booking or package and was credited to the wallet. P-new.packages_none is the C9 tab with no product on sale (F06-T17). F06-T18 (C14): P-new.ledger_credit_* and P-new.ledger_wallet_* are one label per ledger reason (design 12); the ledger_*_in/_out keys are the signed amounts on a history row, singular and plural kept apart (the boards have P-0238 and P-0235 for the court hour plural in and singular out); credits_no_packages and credits_no_history are the empty sections.
